    .ts-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:var(--ts-bg-header);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ts-border)}
    .ts-header-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:56px}
    .ts-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;text-decoration:none}

    .ts-catbar-item.active{color:#fff;background:var(--ts-accent);border-color:var(--ts-accent)}

    .ts-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:var(--ts-bg-header);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ts-border)}
    .ts-header-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:56px}
    .ts-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;text-decoration:none}
    .ts-logo-text{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff6b00,#ff9500);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
    .ts-search{flex:1;max-width:540px;margin:0 auto}

    .ts-search-input{flex:1;padding:9px 16px;background:transparent;color:var(--ts-text);font-size:14px;border:none;outline:none}
    .ts-search-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:9px 16px;background:transparent;color:var(--ts-text-secondary);cursor:pointer;border:none}
    .ts-catbar{background:var(--ts-bg-catbar);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ts-border);overflow:hidden}
    .ts-catbar-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:6px 0}
    .ts-catbar-inner::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    .ts-catbar-item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:8px 14px;min-height:40px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ts-text-secondary);white-space:nowrap;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid transparent}
    .ts-catbar-item.active{color:#fff;background:var(--ts-accent);border-color:var(--ts-accent)}
    .ts-catbar-count{font-size:11px;color:var(--ts-text-muted)}
    .ts-main{min-height:60vh;padding-top:20px;padding-bottom:40px}
    .ts-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:20px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ts-border);flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
    .ts-toolbar-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ts-text)}
    .ts-video-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:var(--ts-gap)}
    .ts-video-card{background:var(--ts-bg-card);border-radius:var(--ts-radius);overflow:hidden}
    .ts-card-thumb{position:relative;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;background:#111}
    .ts-card-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
    .ts-card-info{padding:10px}
    .ts-card-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.35;color:var(--ts-text);margin-bottom:6px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
    .ts-card-title a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
    .ts-card-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--ts-text-muted)}
    .ts-card-duration{position:absolute;bottom:6px;right:6px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);border-radius:var(--ts-radius-sm)}
    .ts-card-quality{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;padding:2px 6px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:#28a745;border-radius:var(--ts-radius-sm);text-transform:uppercase}
    .ts-error-page,.ts-no-results{text-align:center;padding:60px 20px}
    .ts-error-code{font-size:72px;font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff6b00,#ff9500);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;line-height:1;margin-bottom:10px}
    .ts-section-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ts-text)}
    .ts-footer{background:#0a0a0a;border-top:1px solid var(--ts-border);margin-top:40px}
    .ts-mobile-toggle{display:none}
    @media(max-width:1399px){.ts-video-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
    @media(max-width:1099px){.ts-video-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.ts-nav{display:none}.ts-mobile-toggle{display:flex}}
    @media(max-width:767px){.ts-video-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.ts-header-inner{height:50px}.ts-logo-text{font-size:18px}.ts-error-code{font-size:56px}}
